entries.partTitle: Structured JSON Logging vs Plaintext Architecture

spec.title: Unstructured plaintext logs vs StructuredJSONLogger JSON envelopes

steps.caption: Structured JSON envelopes standardize timestamp, level, and service keys.
Single-line JSON envelopes keep stack traces searchable in log aggregators.
Formatting single-line JSON log envelopes pairs metadata with service keys.
Add user_role admin metadata to log1 and verify JSON serialization.

left.whatIf:
import json

class StructuredJSONLogger:
    def __init__(self, service_name: str):
        self.service_name = service_name

    def format_log(self, level: str, message: str, **kwargs) -> str:
        log_record = {
            "timestamp": "2026-10-18T12:00:00.000Z",
            "level": level.upper(),
            "service": self.service_name,
            "message": message,
            "metadata": kwargs
        }
        return json.dumps(log_record, sort_keys=True)

logger = StructuredJSONLogger("order-service")
log1 = logger.format_log("info", "Order placed successfully", order_id="ord_9901", amount=129.50)
log2 = logger.format_log("error", "Payment processing failed", order_id="ord_9902", error_code="ERR_CARD_DECLINED")

print("Log Record 1 (2 keys):")
print(log1)
print("Log Record 2:")
print(log2)
print("Structured Logging Invariant: Single-line JSON envelopes enable high-speed indexation and filtering.")
